content: Figure 1 illustrates the overall architecture of the discourse-level neural network model that consists of two Bi-LSTM layers, one max-pooling layer in between and one softmax prediction layer. The input of the neural network model is a paragraph containing a sequence of discourse units, while the output is a sequence of discourse relations with one relation between each pair of adjacent discourse units.
